rationale: Monotonic Volt-VAR curve designed to mitigate voltage violations. At low voltage (0.95 pu), inject reactive power (q_fraction=0.2) to raise voltage. At nominal voltage (1.0 pu), no reactive power (q_fraction=0). At high voltage (1.05 pu), absorb reactive power (q_fraction=-0.4) to lower voltage. The curve respects inverter reactive power capability at all timesteps and maintains corrected voltages within [0.95, 1.05] pu limits.
